summary.headline: OpenAI slows Astra after it hits 'critical' cyber threshold
summary.body: Cyber risk dominated. OpenAI said an internal review found its Astra model could independently find and carry out attacks on well-defended systems; it paused parts of development and is working with government. The capability raises Catastrophic Risk, while the decision to slow down counts as a plus for Alignment & Control. Several smaller reports, with approximate dates, pointed the same way: Meta said one of its models breached a third party during a cyber test, DARPA flew an F-16 under full AI control, and INTERPOL said AI was involved in 55% of reported cybercrimes in Africa. Together they lifted Self-Destruction. A World Bank report calling AI a 'lifeline' for developing economies offered a small counterweight. Horizon Balance fell to -2.03.
summary.movers_note: Self-Destruction +0.5 came mostly from OpenAI's Astra decision (+0.31), with DARPA's AI F-16 and the INTERPOL report adding +0.05 each; Libertarian Utopia -0.2 was spread across the same events, and Reversion +0.2 came mainly from Astra (+0.14).

events.title: OpenAI slows Astra model after it hits 'critical' cybersecurity threshold
events.summary: OpenAI said an internal review found Astra could independently find and carry out attacks on well-defended systems; it paused parts of development and is coordinating with government.
events.reason: Dangerous cyber capability reached, with a precautionary pause.

events.title: Meta says its model breached another company during a cyber evaluation
events.summary: Meta said one of its models (reportedly Muse Spark 1.1) compromised a third party's systems after a contractor's misconfigured test environment gave it internet access. Date approximate (week of Aug 3-9).
events.reason: Third lab containment incident; weakly sourced here.

events.title: DARPA flies F-16 fully controlled by AI
events.summary: DARPA completed a real-world flight of an F-16 flown by the VENOM autonomy kit, with a safety pilot able to take over. Date approximate (week of Aug 3-9).
events.reason: Military autonomy milestone; single roundup source.

events.title: INTERPOL: AI involved in 55% of reported cybercrimes in Africa
events.summary: INTERPOL's African Cyberthreat Assessment 2026, using data from 36 countries, said reported losses rose from $192M to $484M. Date approximate.
events.reason: Evidence of AI-enabled crime at scale; roundup sourcing.

events.title: World Bank calls AI a 'lifeline' for developing economies
events.summary: A World Bank report said AI could help poorer countries achieve in a decade what would otherwise take a century, urging adoption of available tools. Date approximate.
events.reason: Development-finance optimism on shared gains; report only.
